what: Post-push harness cases wrap publish in `|| true` subshells
scenario_or_breakage: After `design-log-publish.sh` starts exiting 1 on push/merge failure, new `[ "$rc" -eq 1 ]` assertions never run; the exit-code contract ships untested
suggested_fix: Capture exit code explicitly (e.g. `rc=0; out=$(...); rc=$?` without trailing `|| true`) for push-fail and merge-fail cases; assert `rc=1` alongside existing `PUBLISH_OK=false` / `RECOVERY_BRANCH` stdout checks
